per_step.command: cd /app/data && for f in patient_*.json; do echo "=== $f ==="; jq -r '.reporting_period // "current"' "$f"; jq -r '.adverse_events[]? | .severity' "$f"; done
total=10; sae=3; rate=$(echo "scale=2; 100 * $sae / $total" | bc -l); echo "Rate: $rate%"; if (( $(echo "$rate > 12" | bc -l) )); then echo "FAILED"; else echo "PASSED"; fi
if [ $(echo "30.00 > 12" | bc -l) -eq 1 ]; then echo "FAILED: exceeds 12%"; else echo "PASSED"; fi

DATA_DIR=/app/data; total_patients=0; sae_count=0; for f in "$DATA_DIR"/patient_*.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue; reporting_period=$(jq -r '.reporting_period // "unknown"' "$f"); if [[ "$reporting_period" == "current" ]]; then ((total_patients++)) || true; if jq -e '.adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >= 3)' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ((sae_count++)) || true; fi; fi; done; echo "Total: $total_patients, SAE: $sae_count"

bash -c 'DATA_DIR=/app/data; total_patients=0; sae_count=0; for f in "$DATA_DIR"/patient_*.json; do [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue; reporting_period=$(jq -r ".reporting_period // \"unknown\"" "$f"); if [[ "$reporting_period" == "current" ]]; then ((total_patients++)); if jq -e ".adverse_events[]? | select(.severity >= 3)" "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ((sae_count++)); fi; fi; done; echo "Total: $total_patients, SAE: $sae_count"; rate=$(echo "scale=2; 100 * $sae_count / $total_patients" | bc -l); echo "Rate: ${rate}%"'
